species.tagline: A strong beetle of Hong Kong's woodlands

tasks.title: Look at its horn
tasks.message: A male rhinoceros beetle has a horn on its head, for pushing contests with other males.
tasks.subtitle: Hello! This is a rhinoceros beetle. The male's horn is for pushing contests with other males.

tasks.title: It is very strong
tasks.message: It can push things many times its own weight — the strong one of the woodland.
tasks.subtitle: It can push many times its own weight. A small body with a lot of strength.

tasks.title: Help it
tasks.message: Rhinoceros beetles live in the woods and feed on tree sap. No trees, no beetles.
tasks.subtitle: Keep the woodland and the beetle has a home. Thank you!
